name: Matsudaira Keeko
source:
Keeko is a Kyoto guardian, the boss of Shinsengumi and the lord of the Aizu clan. Also, she is an old friend of [url=/c13237]Chamomille Serizawa[/url]. 

In this work, Keeko is based on the samurai [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Matsudaira_Katamori]Matsudaira Katamori[/url].
